text:
Maya (People Ops): Hi team — quick update: starting next Monday we’re rolling out a temporary Onboarding PTO Exception for new hires in their first 30 days. If a new hire has an already-booked trip or an urgent personal emergency during days 1–30, managers can approve up to 3 days PTO without the full carryover/exception flow. This is narrowly scoped to avoid blockers for relocations and urgent travel.

Jordan (Hiring): Nice. Do managers need to log this somewhere?

Maya (People Ops): Yes — please use the short form: https://tinyurl.com/rw-onboard-ex. The form sends an audit email to People Ops + the hiring manager. Approvals should be recorded within 48 hours. Not retroactive except by explicit People Ops review.

Alina (People Ops): For payroll, mark entries as `Paid PTO — Onboard exception` in the HRIS so accruals stay aligned.

Chris (Eng): What about folks on projects with planned sprint freezes?

Maya (People Ops): If PTO falls during a sprint freeze, managers should coordinate coverage; the exception doesn't change code freeze policy. If coverage can't be found, escalate to eng leads and People Ops will help with temporary coverage.

PeopleOps-bot: NOTE: Automated reminder will DM managers when a form is submitted and will post an audit note to #people-ops-approvals.

Jordan (Hiring): Sounds good. Does this affect international relocation pre-approvals?

Maya (People Ops): For relocations, continue using the relocation checklist — exceptions can cover short trips (visits, flights) but not long-term relocation approvals. Ping me for case-by-case reviews.

Alina (People Ops): FYI: We'll run a 60-day review to see usage and spot any patterns. If we see misuse, we’ll tighten the rules.

Chris (Eng): :thumbsup: appreciate the clarity.

Emma (Product): Quick Q — any changes to manager-level auto-approval thresholds?

Maya (People Ops): No changes to thresholds. This remains a manual manager approval + short form that People Ops tracks.

Jordan (Hiring): OK — rolling this out next Monday. Maya, can you add a short blurb to the employee handbook and send a reminder?

Maya (People Ops): Will do — will add the handbook note and post a reminder next week. Thanks all! :rocket:
